preconditions.description: The input string s has length between 5 and 10,000 (inclusive), consisting of lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is a non-negative integer k, representing the count of distinct valid suffixes.
The total number of lines in stdout is exactly k + 1 (k suffixes + the count line).

postconditions.expression: all(len(suffix) in {2, 3} for suffix in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each suffix in the output (lines 2 to k+1) has length exactly 2 or 3.

postconditions.expression: all(suffix in set(s[i:i+L] for i in range(len(s)) for L in [2, 3] if i + L <= len(s)) for suffix in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Every suffix in the output is a substring of length 2 or 3 present in the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(suffix not in {s[i:i+L] for i in range(len(s)-1) if i + L <= len(s) and s[i:i+L] == s[i+L:i+2*L]} for suffix in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:]) or (len(s) < 5 and k == 0)
postconditions.description: A suffix is included in the output only if it does not appear consecutively twice in the input string (i.e., no two identical suffixes of length 2 or 3 appear consecutively in s). If the input string length is less than 5, no suffixes are allowed (k = 0).

postconditions.expression: all(suffix == s[i:i+len(suffix)] for suffix in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:] for i in range(len(s) - len(suffix) + 1) if s[i:i+len(suffix)] == suffix)
postconditions.description: Each suffix in the output is a valid suffix in at least one possible decomposition of s into a root (length > 4) and suffixes (length 2 or 3), with no two identical suffixes appearing consecutively.
All suffixes in the output are distinct (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: sorted(stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:]) == sorted([suffix for suffix in set(s[i:i+L] for i in range(len(s)) for L in [2, 3] if i + L <= len(s)) if not any(suffix == s[i:i+len(suffix)] and suffix == s[i+len(suffix):i+2*len(suffix)] for i in range(len(s) - len(suffix) + 1))])
postconditions.description: The output suffixes are exactly the distinct substrings of length 2 or 3 in s that do not appear consecutively twice in s, sorted lexicographically.
